issue_context.title: RFE: systemd-tmpfiles to support ACL capital 'X' perm
issue_context.body:
### Component

systemd-tmpfiles

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe

Hi, I'd like for systemd-tmpfiles to support the ACL capital 'X' permission, similar to `chmod(1)`:

```
execute/search only if the file is a directory or already has execute permission for some user (X)
```


### Describe the solution you'd like

I'd like to write

```
A /var/lib/syncthing - - - - d:u:syncthing:rwX,u:syncthing:rwX,d:u:bf:rwX,u:bf:rwX
```

and have systemd-tmpfiles ONLY set the execute in bit in ACLs on files/directories that already have the execute permission.

But what acutally happens today:

```
$ sudo systemd-tmpfiles --create
Failed to parse ACL "d:u:syncthing:rwX,u:syncthing:rwX,d:u:bf:rwX,u:bf:rwX": Invalid argument. Ignoring
```


### Describe alternatives you've considered

Keep using lower-case 'x' permission. All files get the execute bit set :-(

### The systemd version you checked that didn't have the feature you are asking for

250.4
